metadata.description: Plugins for coding agents by hoaj: CLI skills for websites, made with site-cli-creator, and the generator itself.

plugins.name: logbuy
plugins.description: Find deals on Visma LogBuy (mylogbuy.com): search products, show a deal, browse categories.

plugins.name: site-cli-creator
plugins.description: Turn the calls a website makes into a plugin of CLI skills that coding agents can run, with Drift checks and a feedback loop.

plugins.name: bank
plugins.description: BankMCP: ask your AI assistant about your own bank accounts. Read-only, self-hosted, on PSD2 open banking via Enable Banking. /bank:setup installs it locally, /bank:deploy hosts it.
